# Bundled boundary data — source and licence

The files in this folder:

- `state_boundary_lite.fgb`
- `district_boundary_lite.fgb`

are simplified administrative boundary geometries for India (polygon geometry
plus the state / district name attributes only), stored in FlatGeobuf format.

**Source:** Survey of India.

**Licence:** Government Open Data License – India (GODL-India),
<https://data.gov.in/government-open-data-license-india>, which permits use,
adaptation and redistribution provided the source is acknowledged.

**Attribution:** Source: Survey of India, used under GODL-India.

The geometries have been simplified (reduced vertex detail) to keep the
package small; they are intended for visual mapping, not for precise
measurement or official boundary determination.
